items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I was playing at the Apollo Theater with Quincy Jones and Redd Foxx was the star... Redd Foxx always kidded me... Redd said, sit down, have a drink... I always wanted to shake hands and say thank you.

ctx.x: Quincy's band was up at the Apollo for a week.

A week or two weeks? Two weeks, the second time was two weeks. And that was right after the riots up there and Redd Foxx used to make the most outrageous remarks. He'd say, 'I saw you all on television. Hey, you out there with the greasy face, didn't I see you with a couple of hams under your arm?' (Laughter.) It's a wonder they didn't come up and kill him. And you know, the funny thing, I was getting the business from the guys on the 'Tonight Show.' Man, you go up there after the riots and everything, aren't you…
